officialSendingAgency.name: Department of Foreign Employment / EPS Korea Section
officialSendingAgency.address: EPS Korea Section, Gwarko, Lalitpur, Nepal

evidenceNotes: HRD Korea lists Nepal's sending agency as the Department of Foreign Employment and the reception office as EPS Korea Section, Gwarko, Lalitpur.

EPS Korea Section Nepal published the 2026 first-phase Korean-language examination application notice on 2026-07-21. The notice uses the Point Based Selection System and includes Manufacturing among the listed sectors/subsectors.
The verified Nepal site also shows 2025 Manufacturing selection processing continuing through 2026, including skill/competency results and employment-application processing.
Nepal remains KEP research HOLD because country-specific document, medical, visa, training and departure requirements are not yet fully mapped into exact-answer rules.

During the 2026 first-phase application window, EPS Korea Section published a temporary-suspension notice and a later resumption notice on 2026-07-28. KEP does not infer any deadline extension from those titles; supplementary content is tracked separately.

As of 2026-10-05, KEP has not promoted a current-2026 first-phase EPS-TOPIK result, Skill & Competency schedule/result, or Manufacturing medical/job-application notice from the official Nepal notice index; 2025-cohort notices remain prior-cycle evidence only.

A March 2026 official EPS Nepal process guide was reviewed for stable post-selection flow, including biometric registration, medical/police checks, employment application, roster, automated job matching, Labor Contract, PDOT, CCVI/visa and final departure. This is process-shape evidence; current-cohort dates, providers and volatile fees remain gated by current official notices.

HRD Korea directly lists the current 5th Nepal Manufacturing(5부) Point System row with registration 2026-07-27 through 2026-08-05, while test announcement/test period remain undecided. Nepal's local primary first-phase notice states 2026-07-27 through 2026-08-02; KEP preserves this cross-source end-date discrepancy without inferring a deadline extension.

stages.title: Eligibility check
stages.authority: EPS Korea Section Nepal / HRD Korea
stages.action: For the 2026 first-phase notice, verify Nepali citizenship, age 18–39 (birth date 1986-07-28 through 2008-07-27), criminal/deportation/travel-ban history, prior E-9/E-10 stay under 5 years, and color-vision eligibility.
stages.warning: Passing EPS-TOPIK or another selection stage does not guarantee employment in Korea.

stages.title: Official EPS application / registration
stages.authority: EPS Korea Section Nepal
stages.action: The Nepal primary 2026 first-phase notice set 2026-07-27 through 2026-08-02. HRD Korea's current 5th Nepal Manufacturing(5부) schedule row lists 2026-07-27 through 2026-08-05. KEP keeps 2026-08-02 as the applicant-facing exact local-primary deadline until a later Nepal notice is content-reviewed and proven to extend/modify it.
stages.officialActionLabel: Open official EPS Nepal application portal
stages.warning: Do not treat HRD Korea's 2026-08-05 schedule-row end date as automatic proof that Nepal locally extended the application deadline.

stages.title: EPS-TOPIK fee payment
stages.authority: EPS Korea Section Nepal / HRD Korea
stages.action: Official fee under the 2026 first-phase notice: US$28 equivalent in NPR, converted using the Nepal Rastra Bank exchange rate on the application date and paid online through the official application flow.

stages.title: Identity / biometric requirements
stages.authority: EPS Korea Section Nepal / HRD Korea
stages.action: The official Nepal EPS process baseline places biometric registration at EPS Korea Section, Gwarko on the day before the assigned exam date with the original passport and admission card. Use the current cohort schedule for the exact appointment.

stages.title: Application document verification
stages.authority: EPS Korea Section Nepal / HRD Korea
stages.action: Use the 2026 primary notice as the verified baseline for passport/photo uploads. A later 2026-07-30 official notice specifically concerns online submission and passport; its exact content remains under review, so do not present the primary passport rule as exhaustive.

stages.title: Exam admission document
stages.authority: EPS Korea Section Nepal / HRD Korea
stages.action: HRD Korea directly lists the current 5th Nepal Manufacturing(5부) Point System row, but the test-announcement date and test period are still undecided. Do not invent an individual exam date/session.

stages.title: EPS-TOPIK
stages.authority: HRD Korea
stages.action: The current HRD Korea 5th Nepal Manufacturing(5부) row is General CBT / Point System. Its test announcement and test period remain undecided. The verified first-stage format remains Reading 20/25m + Listening 20/25m; wait for the official assigned schedule.

stages.title: Skill & competency test
stages.authority: HRD Korea / EPS Korea Section Nepal
stages.action: A Skill & Competency Test is part of the point-based selection flow, but current 2026 first-phase applicant scheduling is not yet asserted from the older 2025 cohort notice. Do not reuse the 2025 schedule as a 2026 schedule.

stages.title: Final point-system selection
stages.authority: HRD Korea / EPS Korea Section Nepal
stages.action: Selection is point-based. One applicant may apply to only one sector, the sector cannot be changed after passing the first-stage language test, and the final successful-candidate result is valid for 2 years from publication.

stages.title: Pre-job country-specific checks
stages.authority: EPS Korea Section Nepal
stages.action: No separate Nepal psychology stage is verified in the official Nepal EPS process baseline. Do not copy Indonesia's psychology requirement into the Nepal route.

stages.title: Medical examination before job application
stages.authority: EPS Korea Section Nepal / designated provider
stages.action: The official Nepal EPS process baseline requires a designated-hospital medical examination and an online police report. The March 2026 guide lists Civil, Shukraraj, Korea Friendship and Patan hospitals and a baseline medical fee of US$55.64, but the 2026 first-phase cohort's current provider/fee notice is still required before payment.

stages.title: Employment application
stages.authority: EPS Korea Section Nepal / HRD Korea
stages.action: The official Nepal EPS process baseline uses passport, ID photo, medical report, police report and employment application form and states a US$5 online fee. The 2026 first-phase cohort must wait for its own official job-application notice before exact dates/documents are promoted.
stages.warning: The June 25, 2026 Manufacturing notice belongs to the 2025 cohort and must not be reused as the 2026 first-phase submission window.

stages.title: Job-seeker roster
stages.authority: HRD Korea / EPS Korea Section Nepal
stages.action: After the employment application is transmitted into Korea's EPS/SPAS system, applicants can follow status using the official EPS system and their EPS-TOPIK ID.

stages.title: Korean employer selection
stages.authority: Korean employer / EPS
stages.action: Employer matching is handled through Korea's online automated job-matching system. Sending-agency/EPS staff and private intermediaries cannot legitimately guarantee or manually force a specific employer selection.

stages.title: Standard Labour Contract (SLC)
stages.authority: HRD Korea / EPS Korea Section Nepal
stages.action: When an official Labor Contract/SLC is forwarded, follow the current EPS Nepal contract notice and appear in person at EPS Korea Section, Gwarko to sign. Current notices may impose a specific signing/contact deadline.

stages.title: Post-SLC country-specific requirements
stages.authority: EPS Korea Section Nepal / HRD Korea
stages.action: After SLC, follow Nepal's current EPS contract/departure notices for training, CCVI, visa and any medical/document follow-up. The stable process baseline is known, but current-cohort exact instructions remain notice-gated.

stages.title: Visa and departure document package
stages.authority: EPS Korea Section Nepal / Korean mission
stages.action: After CCVI issuance, the official baseline uses a passport/ID-photo/medical/police/citizenship/admission-card/PDOT package for visa processing. Visa/service fees and payment locations changed multiple times in 2026, so only the latest official notice may supply the current amount/location.

stages.title: Pre-departure preparation / training
stages.authority: EPS Korea Section Nepal / designated institution
stages.action: The official Nepal EPS baseline includes a 6-day pre-departure training at the National Vocational Training Institute, Bhaisepati, with online application. The March 2026 guide states US$63; current category/cohort notices must be checked before payment or attendance.

stages.title: Final health / departure readiness
stages.authority: EPS Korea Section Nepal
stages.action: No separate Nepal final-health-check stage equivalent to Indonesia's MCU-III is verified. Follow the current Nepal departure notice if a final medical recheck is explicitly required.

stages.title: Departure to Korea
stages.authority: EPS Korea Section Nepal / HRD Korea
stages.action: The official Nepal EPS baseline requires the final EPS Nepal flight notice, Nepal labor approval through FEIMS, and scheduled pre-departure instructions before the assigned flight. Departure may be from Kathmandu TIA or Gautam Buddha International Airport, Bhairahawa, according to the official flight assignment.

stages.title: Korea entry + employment education
stages.authority: HRD Korea / employment training institution
stages.action: After entry, complete the official employment education and handover process.

stages.title: Employer handover
stages.authority: Employment training institution / employer
stages.action: Confirm workplace, accommodation and emergency contacts at official handover.

stages.title: Residence Registration
stages.authority: Korea Immigration Service
stages.action: After arrival, follow the current Korea Immigration rules for foreigner registration / Residence Card.

stages.title: Eps Insurance Check
stages.authority: HRD Korea EPS / employer / worker
stages.action: Confirm the required EPS insurance obligations through the official EPS information.

stages.title: First Payroll Check
stages.authority: Employer / Ministry of Employment and Labor
stages.action: Compare the first payslip and bank deposit with the contract, working hours and applicable wage rules.

stages.title: Labor Support Ready
stages.authority: Ministry of Employment and Labor
stages.action: Keep official labor-support channels and your contract, payslips, bank deposits and attendance records ready.

stages.title: Employment Maintenance
stages.authority: MOEL employment center / EPS
stages.action: For Nepal, re-registration is described for applicants who remain on the roster and were not selected during the first year; use only a current official re-registration notice. After arrival, workplace changes use Korea's official EPS/employment-center process.
